rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is poor or lacks basic material means.

example.english: This charity specializes in helping needy people.
example.traditional: 呢間慈善機構專門幫窮人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3 zyun1 mun4 bong1 kung4 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the needy behaviour shows itself as clinginess or a constant desire for another person's attention.

example.english: Her boyfriend is so needy that he always wants me to stay with him.
example.traditional: 佢個男朋友好黐身，成日要我陪住佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 naam4 pang4 jau5 hou2 ci1 san1 seng4 jat6 jiu3 ngo5 pui4 zyu6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for the insecure, reassurance-seeking side of emotional neediness rather than its outwardly clingy behaviour.

example.english: They keep asking whether I still love them; they’re really needy.
example.traditional: 佢成日問我仲愛唔愛佢，真係好冇安全感。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 man6 ngo5 zung6 oi3 m4 oi3 keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 on1 cyun4 gam2
